title: Simple or Continuous?
subtitle: Every day, or now?
review: Written by Claude. Check the Burmese, Spanish, Hindi and Vietnamese (explanations and scene translations) and the answers. No pictures or audio yet.
intro: Lucas cooks dinner, or is cooking dinner: Emma would like to know which. Four short scenes, then the rule, the mistakes to watch for, practice and a quiz.
clips: You cook dinner? Every day? Since when?
No. Now. I am cooking dinner now.
Lucas, the cat is sitting on your laptop.
She is sending an email to your boss.
I want coffee. I need coffee. I love coffee.
I know. You are drinking my coffee.
Why are you taking the car today?

lines.text: You [[cook]] dinner? Every day? Since when?

q.my: ဇာတ်ကွက် ၁ တွင် Emma ဘာကြောင့် အံ့ဩသွားသလဲ။
q.vi: Cảnh 1: vì sao Emma ngạc nhiên?

a.my: I [[cook]] dinner ဟုဆိုလျှင် 'နေ့တိုင်း ချက်တယ်' ဟု အဓိပ္ပာယ်ရသည်။ အခုအတွက် I [[am cooking]] ဟု ပြောရသည်။
a.en: I [[cook]] dinner means every day. For now, he needs I [[am cooking]].
a.es: I [[cook]] dinner significa todos los días. Para ahora hace falta I [[am cooking]].
a.vi: I [[cook]] dinner nghĩa là ngày nào cũng nấu. Nói về bây giờ thì phải dùng I [[am cooking]].
a.hi: I [[cook]] dinner का मतलब है रोज़। अभी के लिए I [[am cooking]] चाहिए।

q.my: ဇာတ်ကွက် ၂ တွင် every day နှင့် ဘယ်ပုံစံ တွဲသလဲ။ now နှင့်ရော။
q.en: Scene 2: which form goes with every day? Which goes with now?
q.es: Escena 2: ¿qué forma va con every day? ¿Y con now?
q.vi: Cảnh 2: dạng nào đi với every day? Dạng nào đi với now?
q.hi: दृश्य 2: every day के साथ कौन सा रूप है? now के साथ कौन सा?

a.my: every day → [[sits]], [[types]]။ now → [[is sitting]], [[is typing]]။

q.my: ဇာတ်ကွက် ၃ တွင် Lucas သည် အခု ကော်ဖီလိုချင်နေသည်။ I am wanting ဟု ပြောသလား။
q.en: Scene 3: Lucas wants coffee right now. Does he say I am wanting?
q.es: Escena 3: Lucas quiere café ahora mismo. ¿Dice I am wanting?
q.vi: Cảnh 3: Lucas đang muốn uống cà phê ngay lúc này. Anh ấy có nói I am wanting không?
q.hi: दृश्य 3: लुकास को अभी कॉफ़ी चाहिए। क्या वह I am wanting कहता है?

a.my: မပြောပါ။ I [[want]]၊ I [[need]]၊ I [[love]]၊ I [[know]]။ ဤကြိယာများကို -ing ဖြင့် မသုံးပါ။
a.en: No. I [[want]], I [[need]], I [[love]], I [[know]]. These verbs do not take -ing.
a.es: No. I [[want]], I [[need]], I [[love]], I [[know]]. Estos verbos no llevan -ing.
a.vi: Không. I [[want]], I [[need]], I [[love]], I [[know]]. Những động từ này không thêm -ing.
a.hi: नहीं। I [[want]], I [[need]], I [[love]], I [[know]]. इन क्रियाओं में -ing नहीं लगता।

my: Present Simple − နေ့တိုင်း၊ အမြဲ၊ ပုံမှန် လုပ်သောအရာ။ အချက်ပြစကားလုံး − [[every day]], [[usually]], [[always]]။
Present Continuous − အခု၊ ဒီနေ့၊ ယာယီ ဖြစ်နေသောအရာ။ အချက်ပြစကားလုံး − [[now]], [[today]], [[Look!]]
မြန်မာလို 'ချက်တယ်' နှင့် 'ချက်နေတယ်' ကွာသကဲ့သို့ အင်္ဂလိပ်တွင် I cook နှင့် I am cooking ကွာသည်။
[[want, need, like, love, know]] စသော ကြိယာများကို -ing ပုံစံဖြင့် မသုံးပါ။ အခုအတွက်ပင် I [[want]] ဟု ပြောသည်။
en: Present simple: every day, always, usually. Signal words: [[every day]], [[usually]], [[always]].
Present continuous: now, today, for a short time. Signal words: [[now]], [[today]], [[Look!]]
I cook = it is my habit. I am cooking = I am in the middle of it.
Some verbs do not take -ing: [[want, need, like, love, know]]. Even for now, say I [[want]].
es: Present simple: todos los días, siempre, normalmente. Palabras clave: [[every day]], [[usually]], [[always]].
Present continuous: ahora, hoy, por poco tiempo. Palabras clave: [[now]], [[today]], [[Look!]]
En español ¿Qué haces? sirve para ahora. En inglés no: para ahora se dice What [[are]] you [[doing]]?
Algunos verbos no llevan -ing: [[want, need, like, love, know]]. Aunque sea ahora, di I [[want]].
vi: Hiện tại đơn: hằng ngày, luôn luôn, thường xuyên. Từ nhận biết: [[every day]], [[usually]], [[always]].
Hiện tại tiếp diễn: bây giờ, hôm nay, tạm thời. Từ nhận biết: [[now]], [[today]], [[Look!]]
Tiếng Việt có thể bỏ chữ 'đang'. Tiếng Anh thì không: nói về bây giờ phải dùng am / is / are + -ing.
Một số động từ không thêm -ing: [[want, need, like, love, know]]. Dù là bây giờ, vẫn nói I [[want]].
hi: Present simple: रोज़, हमेशा, आम तौर पर। संकेत शब्द: [[every day]], [[usually]], [[always]].
Present continuous: अभी, आज, थोड़े समय के लिए। संकेत शब्द: [[now]], [[today]], [[Look!]]
'बनाता हूँ' और 'बना रहा हूँ' में जो फ़र्क है, वही I cook और I am cooking में है।
कुछ क्रियाओं में -ing नहीं लगता: [[want, need, like, love, know]]. अभी के लिए भी I [[want]] कहें, I am wanting नहीं।

note.es: ¿Qué haces? para ahora = What are you doing?

note.hi: अपनी चीज़ बताने के लिए have, am having नहीं।

note.my: now ပါလျှင် am / is / are + -ing။
note.en: With now, use am / is / are + -ing.
note.vi: Có now: dùng am / is / are + -ing.
note.hi: now के साथ am / is / are + -ing.

mistakes.wrong: She is going to school every day.

note.my: every day ပါလျှင် Present Simple။
note.en: With every day, use the present simple.
note.vi: Có every day: dùng hiện tại đơn.
note.hi: every day के साथ present simple.

note.my: want ကို -ing ဖြင့် မသုံးပါ။
know ကို -ing ဖြင့် မသုံးပါ။

mistakes.wrong: He is usually walking to work.

note.my: usually ပါလျှင် Present Simple။ -s ကိုလည်း မမေ့ပါနှင့်။
note.en: With usually, use the present simple, and remember the -s.
note.es: Con usually: present simple, y no olvides la -s.
note.vi: Có usually: dùng hiện tại đơn, và nhớ thêm -s.
note.hi: usually के साथ present simple, और -s न भूलें।
